source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The notification template uses details and summary, with role=alert and aria-describedby for available description content. Current showNotification controls details.open and may add aria-disabled when there is no description. CSS limits pointer interaction, but aria-disabled and pointer rules alone do not prove keyboard toggling is prevented. A focused review should check actual summary keyboard behavior, focus, description relationship and announcement for all severities. This is an explicit manual-review proposal; no live accessibility tree, keyboard or screen-reader validation ran.
title: Verify native disclosure interaction as well as the notification visual state
